input.question: What is the population of Croydon Park?

documents.text: Croydon Park , commonly mistaken for Croydon , boasts numerous parks and parklands , particularly close to the Cooks River . Picken Oval is home to the Western Suburbs Magpies Australian Rules team . Lees Park is a homeground of Canterbury Junior Soccer Association and tennis courts . Other parks and reserves include Flockhart Park , Jackson Park , Rosedale Reserve and Croydon Park .
